sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A robust orchid, usually epiphytic, about 50–125 cm tall. Its spindle-shaped pseudobulbs bear long, narrow leaves; branched inflorescences carry numerous yellow flowers marked with dark brown or red. It is native to tropical and southern Africa, growing on trees in open woodland and wooded grassland, sometimes on rocks, up to about 2,200 m.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: Sources document traditional medicinal and symbolic uses, but no food use.
